items.title: Anthropic shipped Claude Fable 5.1
items.oneliner: Claude Fable 5.1 targets long-running coding work, and its 66 AA score puts autonomous agents back on the roadmap.

items.title: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.oneliner: Google says Gemini 3.8 Flash beats larger models at the same price, which is exactly the pressure buyers wanted.

items.title: Neural nets look more symbolic
items.oneliner: This paper argues symbolic structure emerges inside neural nets, giving interpretability researchers a cleaner handle for targeted interventions.

items.title: Perplexity's citations failed basic verification
items.oneliner: An audit found 34.7% of Perplexity citations missed the claimed number, which makes enterprise trust a product problem.

items.title: Mistral trains on user data by default
items.oneliner: Mistral uses prompts and uploads for training unless users opt out, so privacy defaults still lag enterprise expectations.

items.title: Claude can verify generated files
items.oneliner: Anthropic added C2PA-based file checks for Claude outputs, a practical provenance move as synthetic media becomes operational risk.

items.title: Pixel 11 MTE support looks crippled
items.oneliner: GrapheneOS says Pixel 11 has MTE support mostly disabled in firmware, which is a bad sign for memory-safety progress.

items.title: Agent harness costs vary wildly
items.oneliner: FrontierHarness found nine agent harnesses varied 17x in cost per pass, so orchestration now matters as much as models.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 fixes stale replica reads
items.oneliner: PostgreSQL 19 can wait for a target LSN before reading replicas, finally giving read-your-own-writes a first-class path.

items.title: WebLLM pushes inference into browsers
items.oneliner: WebLLM brings OpenAI-style APIs to in-browser inference over WebGPU, making private local copilots much easier to ship.
